What it does

Longer meals and buff scrolls: 8%. Goes on an armor piece. All your armor together stops at 40%. Lasts 500 kills that pay you XP.

Dropped by monsters of level 23 and up, below level 36. About augments. Placeholder: which monsters give which kind is still unknown.
